summary.zh-CN: 把 LLM 的逐 token 输出优雅地接进界面:增量渲染、跳动光标、滚动锚定、随时可中断。本 demo 用客户端模拟的 token 流演示这一前端模式,不触网、不调用真实模型。
summary.en-US: Gracefully receive an LLM's token stream in the UI: incremental render, blinking caret, scroll anchoring, interruptible. This demo simulates the stream client-side — no network, no real model call.
